headline: The GameStop short squeeze
story: Reddit traders drove GameStop up eightfold in four days to sink the funds betting against it. A week later it was nearly all gone.

headline: The COVID crash
story: As COVID-19 spread, the S&P 500 lost a third of its value in a month, its fastest fall on record. Then emergency aid set off a rebound.

headline: Steve Jobs unveils the iPhone
story: Steve Jobs unveiled the iPhone on January 9, 2007, and Apple stock jumped 8% that day. In hindsight, that was underreacting.
